Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Dear Zehao, I hope you are doing well. My name is Sara from Avicenna. I wanted to personally welcome you to our research community. We built Avicenna to help researchers automate their research work including field deployment, data collection, and monitoring. I’ve created a slide deck to highlight some of the features of our product.If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me, or the support team. You can also visit our support knowledge base which provides helpful hints for the entire platform as well as our forum page where other researchers share their questions and thoughts. I've also received your license upgrade request for your study, "Smartphone use". Generally, our pricing depends on three factors: The type of data you plan to collect (only surveys and experience sampling, or sensor data as well) The participation period (how long each participant will be enrolled in your study) The maximum number of participants you expect to enroll I would be able to help you better if you share more information about your study with me.Sincerely,Sara--Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com--------
